senses.gloss: (b. h., √אב , v. אבב; cmp. אפל); [dark, cmp. קֹדֵר], mourner, esp. during seven days after burial.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 14b:8">M. Kat. 14ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>אֲבֵלִים</he>, (<cite ref="A00135"><he>אֲבֵילִין</he></cite>) <cite ref="A00135"><he>אֲבֵילִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:3:4">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אֲבֵילֵי גויים</he> mourners among gentiles; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="A00131"><he>אֲבֵילָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00160"><he>אֲבֵלָה</he></cite>. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ; Y. Taan. II, 65ᶜ bot.
